### T1-nn. Sensitivity: served-wrong % over reads whose oracle value is NOT 'NONE' (referent present), every commit

The oracle answers NONE when the referent is gone, including when a question's pinned file path moved (e.g. jinja's move to src/) and at transient breakages (a commit whose file does not parse).
